title: The last-ten-minutes audit
prompt: You have 4 minutes left and an FRQ method still unguarded. Which two point-savers does the protocol demand? The method below should return the FIRST reading below 0.0 or 999.0 when none. Add BOTH: the empty-input guard and the sentinel return.

tests.name: audited method
tests.hint: Empty input falls through the loop; the sentinel (999.0) replaces the placeholder 0.
